* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Dec 14, 2024

## [I would give zero stars if I could](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/675cbbf6028a0c5bd0e0038c)
I would give zero stars if I could. One of the worst shopping experiences I’ve ever had. Place an order 12/9. Was guaranteed it would ship in 2-3 days. 5 days later, it still hasn’t shipped. And the company won’t respond to multiple attempts to contact them. This was supposed to be a gift. And now it won’t arrive in time. If I had known it would take this long , I would not have ordered it.

December 9, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Dec 16, 2024

I’m sorry to hear about your experience and the delay with your order. Due to higher-than-normal email volume, our response times have been slower than usual. Our team will respond as soon as possible.

We understand how disappointing this must be, especially for a gift, and we’re working hard to get your order to you as quickly as we can. Thank you for your patience, and please don’t hesitate to reach out with any further concerns.
